source.label: Public project documentation

items.title: The private deadline correction passed focused verification

queries.summary: The new deadline regression failed on the older engine; after the exact upstream correction, all 35 workflow and import tests passed.

source.label: Local regression evidence
caveats: This is a focused local Node 24.18.0 check, not the full public suite, native integration or a comparative coding benchmark.

evidenceFlow.title: Before correction
evidenceFlow.detail: Workflow suite: 21 tests, 20 passed and one failed; the failure was the new deadline regression.

evidenceFlow.title: After correction
evidenceFlow.detail: Combined workflow and source-import suites: 35 tests passed, zero failed. Engine and workflow test file matched the reviewed upstream revision exactly.

metricDefinitions.label: Incorrect completion claims

Tasks, tools, models, tests and budgets must be matched; prevention policies require a separate held-out evaluation.
